source: Social Health Authority (SHA) Gazetted Tariffs & Benefit Packages 2024/2026

facilityLevels.name: National Teaching & Referral Hospitals (KNH, MTRH, KUTRRH)

packages.name: Maternity Care (Linda Mama Replacement)
packages.notes: Covers antenatal visits, delivery, post-natal care and neonatal emergency support

packages.name: Renal Dialysis Package
packages.copay: KES 0 in accredited public & mission centers
packages.notes: Requires nephrologist prescription and biometric SHA pre-authorization

packages.name: Oncology & Chemotherapy
packages.coveredAmount: KES 25,000–150,000 per cycle depending on regimen
packages.copay: Variable co-pay in private contracted centers
packages.notes: Includes basic chemotherapy drugs and pre-treatment diagnostic workup

packages.name: Major Surgical Theater Package
packages.coveredAmount: KES 50,000 to KES 250,000 based on procedure classification
packages.notes: Requires referral letter from Level 3 or 4 hospital

packages.name: Primary Outpatient Package
packages.coveredAmount: Unlimited essential consultations and prescribed basic drugs
packages.copay: KES 0 at designated primary empaneled facility
packages.notes: Members select their primary healthcare network provider annually
